findings.title: Unguarded Console Statements in Production Code
findings.file: src/App.tsx, src/components/ExpenseTracker.tsx, src/components/InviteModal.tsx, src/components/MultiCityPlanner.tsx, src/components/StopVoteButtons.tsx, src/components/ExpenseSplitSummary.tsx, src/components/TravelCopilot.tsx
findings.description: 11 console statements (2 console.log, 9 console.error) remain unguarded in production code paths. Prior review requested wrapping all console statements in 'if (import.meta.env.DEV)' checks or removing them. The fix only applied guards to SOME console.error in App.tsx but left console.log unguarded and missed console statements in 7 component files.
findings.evidence: App.tsx line 84: 'console.log(`Migrating ${localTrips.length} saved trips from guest mode...`)' - executes on every login after guest usage. App.tsx line 108: 'console.log(`Migrating ${localBucket.length} bucket list trips...`)' - executes on login. ExpenseTracker.tsx lines 101, 116: unguarded console.error in catch blocks. InviteModal.tsx lines 34, 55: unguarded console.error. MultiCityPlanner.tsx line 161: unguarded console.error. StopVoteButtons.tsx lines 31, 48: unguarded console.error. ExpenseSplitSummary.tsx line 103: unguarded console.error. TravelCopilot.tsx line 95: unguarded console.error.
findings.impact: Browser console pollution in production builds. Information disclosure risk - error objects may contain user IDs, email addresses, database error details, or API endpoint structures. Minor performance overhead from console I/O.
findings.correction: Wrap ALL console statements in 'if (import.meta.env.DEV) { }' checks. Example: Replace 'console.log(`Migrating...`)' with 'if (import.meta.env.DEV) { console.log(`Migrating...`); }'. Apply to all 11 identified locations. Alternative: Remove console statements entirely where user-facing toast messages already provide feedback.
